description: Lets the Shield UI, served from GitHub Pages, drive the local agent. Tauri v2 subjects remote origins to ACL resolution, so without a matching entry in remote.urls the page gets no IPC at all and every command is refused. The path pattern MUST be /** - a single /* does not match a nested path like /A1/shield.html, which is exactly how this failed the first time. Both forms plus the bare origin are listed so a pattern-matcher change in a future Tauri release cannot silently take the agent offline.
